edge.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-8177
edge.description: The native component relation and the recombinant assembly experiment are joined here with the preparation qualification. The source reports apparent initiator-Met removal from the 420-aa encoded chain, consistent with a 419-aa processed enzyme; other recombinant terminal changes are unverified. Analytical ultracentrifugation found a predominant species representing about 75% of loading protein, with corrected sedimentation coefficient 7.29 ± 0.10 S and equilibrium mass 132 ± 12 kDa. Comparison with calculated monomer mass 47.644 kDa supports a dominant homotrimer. The preparation was not shown to be exclusively trimeric, and the native component slot supplies no stoichiometric coefficient.

edge.description: The source reports apparent initiator-Met removal from the 420-aa encoded chain, consistent with a 419-aa processed enzyme; other recombinant terminal changes are unverified. The purified enzyme was 1 mg/ml in 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.0, treated for 30 min at 4 °C before activity was initiated with 250 micromolar gallate. 1 mM EDTA left less than 1% of untreated activity. This is an in-vitro exposure result; no cellular flux or specific metal-occupancy mechanism is asserted. The source names EDTA without a salt or protonation specification. CHEBI:4735 is the canonical named parent-acid reference for that reagent; this normalization does not identify the assayed microspecies, supplied salt, charge or stoichiometry.
